All done — the solution in `meetup.js` passes all 95 tests and lints cleanly.

## Implementation

`meetup(year, month, week, weekday)` handles the five week values:

- **`teenth`** — scans days 13–19 and returns the first one whose weekday matches.
- **`last`** — starts at the last day of the month (`new Date(year, month, 0)` gives the previous month's day 0, i.e. the last day of the target month) and walks back up to 6 days to find the match.
- **`first`/`second`/`third`/`fourth`** — finds the first occurrence of the weekday in the month, then adds `7 × (n − 1)` days.

Weekday names map to `Date.getDay()` indices (Sunday = 0 … Saturday = 6), and results are returned as `new Date(year, month - 1, day)` since JS months are 0-based.
